purpose: Define what may be reused by another BlackGold storefront without copying market-specific commercial data.
port_rules: Create a new project identity and market before activation.
Start commercial registries default-deny and locked.
Never copy US affiliate approvals, candidate hashes, tracking links, or activation ledgers into another market.
Reuse guard, rollback, receipts, release-gate patterns and task allowlisting.
Rebuild product, retailer, legal and affiliate registries from sources appropriate to the target market.
No public branch is modified by portability operations.
